scenes.en: Women, this one is for you.
scenes.say: Women over forty, do your eyes feel dry and gritty? Here is why.

scenes.en: Hormones change around menopause. Tear glands and oil glands make less.
scenes.say: Around menopause, hormone levels change. The glands that make tears, and the tiny oil glands in the eyelids, can make less. So tears dry up faster.

scenes.en: Dry eye is more common in women, and more common with age.
scenes.say: Did you know? Studies show dry eye is more common in women than men, and it becomes more common with age.

scenes.en: Burning, grittiness, watery eyes, tired eyes by evening
scenes.say: Signs include burning, a sandy feeling, tired eyes by evening, and even watery eyes.

scenes.en: Blink often on screens. Keep fans and AC off your face. Drink water.
scenes.say: Blink fully and often, especially on screens. Keep fans and A C from blowing on your face. Drink enough water. And ask an eye specialist before using any eye drops.

scenes.en: Pain, strong redness, light hurts, or vision drops
scenes.ta: வலி, சிவப்பு, பார்வை குறைவு: உடனே கண் மருத்துவர்
scenes.say: See an eye specialist urgently if you have eye pain, strong redness, light hurts your eyes, or your vision drops.
